records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating revenues decreased 3.0% for the three months ended June 30, 2023, compared to the same period of the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Logistics volume and revenues remained strong in second quarter 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Expense items that impacted the overall operating ratio are described on the following pages.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Trucking fuel surcharge revenues decreased 35.4% to $76.7 million in second quarter 2023 from $118.6 million in second quarter 2022 due primarily to much lower average diesel fuel prices.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Werner Logistics operating income decreased to $4.4 million in second quarter 2023 from $12.5 million in second quarter 2022, due to a seasonally soft and competitive freight and rate market in second quarter 2023 compared to a seasonally strong freight market in second quarter 2022.
